title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . About the Role: DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically. This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps.. What You'll Own: Campaign Strategy & Execution Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication. Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs. Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets. Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers. Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions. Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback. . Measurement & Optimization Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI. Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance. Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market. Cross-Functional Collaboration Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability. Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums. What You'll Bring: 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles. Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution. Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales. Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines. Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization. Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams. AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution. Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage). Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech. Technical Requirements - nice to have: Marketing Automation: HubSpot CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent) ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred) Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world. You'll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling. If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team's, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we'd love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default. A faster, more autonomous team → Engineers ship models confidently without you reviewing every line; your reports are visibly levelling up. Architecture that holds → Your design decisions — dynamic tables vs. incremental models, how a new portfolio company's data enters the model, orchestration choices — hold up as sources and consumers multiply, and design flaws get caught in review, not production. Trust through ownership → Stakeholders across product, growth, finance, and CX bring you problems, not tickets, because you communicate early and their reporting hasn't broken under them. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p></p> <h3>What does the team work on?&nbsp;</h3> <p>The Ads Customer Interfaces team develops full-stack web application services, APIs, and UIs that provide a unified approach to interfacing with internal and external customers across Roku's suite of advertising products. Our mission is to provide the best-in-class user experience and service while aiming to delight users of our products by making their jobs easier and allowing them to focus on their customers instead of getting bogged down by tedious business processes. In this role, you will work as a key member of the Ads Customer Interfaces team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What is the role?</h3> <p>Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.</p> <p>Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. To be successful you’ll need extensive experience of building reliable and scalable cloud-based solutions, a strong background in software engineering and an appetite to keep on top of modern software practices. This is a great role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility and thrives on great business impact.</p> <p>The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>&nbsp;<br>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p>&nbsp;<br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What are the responsiblities of the role?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deliver high-quality web applications and back-end services with modern frameworks and technologies.</li> <li>Work as a part of a high functioning team consisting of UX designers, software engineers, dev-ops, quality assurance and product management.</li> <li>Build and integrate AI-powered features into web applications and enterprise tools.</li> <li>Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to power chatbot interactions</li> <li>Work both independently and paired with other team members to ensure efficient delivery of prioritised features.</li> <li>Take part in the planning and refinement of features along with the team to come up with innovative and collaborative designs.</li> <li>Develop new features and write test cases to ensure the quality of your code.</li> <li>Work with CI/CD tools to ensure that all software developed adheres to both quality and scaling requirements.</li> <li>Take a role in continuously improving our software delivery process, making it as efficient as possible, reducing wasteful activities and creating value.</li> <li>See a feature go all the way from design stage to being deployed into customer facing environments.</li> <li>Demonstrate the ability to dig deep to find solutions to challenging problems affecting our users.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive expeirence&nbsp; in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Express) on cloud-based technology, such as AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Experience of building large scale and low latency distributed systems.</li> <li>Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimisation techniques, object-oriented programming.</li> <li>Experience using modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows in day-to-day engineering using&nbsp;AI/ML APIs and SDKs</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing RAG solutions or working with LLMs for chatbots is preferred</li> <li>In-depth understanding of CI/CD and the tools used to implement them, such as Jenkins.</li> <li>Experience with software repository tools, such as GitLab and GitHub.</li> <li>Experience with productivity tools, such as Jira and Confluence.</li> <li>A good understanding of Agile practices.</li> <li>Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule.</li> <li>Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred.</li> <li>Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)</li> <li>Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applications</li> <li>Familiarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practices</li> <li>Bachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-PA1</strong></p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

title: Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
description: Build the security foundations behind cutting-edge construction technology At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes. As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, our technology – and the security environment supporting it – is becoming increasingly sophisticated. Our stack spans Kubernetes on Azure, mobile and embedded AR, REST APIs, real-time collaboration and AI-powered data pipelines. We already hold SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but as our product, customers and use of AI continue to evolve, we now need dedicated security expertise within the business. We’re looking for an experienced Senior Security & Compliance Engineer to take ownership of security across XYZ Reality and help build a security capability that can scale with us. The Role This is a critical hire and an opportunity to become our first dedicated security specialist, with genuine ownership and influence across the business. While we already have established compliance activity and SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, security responsibilities currently sit across different teams. We’re now looking for someone who can bring that together, identify where we need to strengthen our approach and provide dedicated technical security leadership as we scale. This is first and foremost a technical security role. You’ll sit within Engineering and work directly alongside the teams building our technology, participating in architecture discussions, development workflows and technical decision-making rather than operating as a separate security function reviewing work after the fact. You’ll take ownership of security architecture across our technology stack, embed shift-left security practices into how we build, strengthen our cloud and application security, and ensure we remain ahead of both established and emerging threats. As our use of AI continues to develop, you’ll also help us understand and respond to new AI-related security risks and attack vectors, ensuring our security approach evolves alongside our technology. Compliance remains an important part of the role. You’ll help strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture and support areas including GDPR, data residency and enterprise customer requirements. However, we’re looking for someone who brings strong hands-on security expertise first, alongside the governance and compliance knowledge needed to operate effectively across both areas. You won’t simply inherit a security playbook, you’ll have the opportunity to help build one. The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work closely with our Engineering, Product and wider business teams. What You’ll Be Doing Take ownership of security architecture and technical security across XYZ Reality’s technology environment. Assess our current security posture, identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, and develop pragmatic remediation plans. Architect and strengthen security across our Azure cloud environment, including Kubernetes clusters, databases and data pipelines. Own and improve areas including IAM, zero-trust networking, secrets management, RBAC, pod security and encryption. Embed shift-left security into engineering workflows, integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning and SCA into our CI/CD pipelines. Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams on architectural decisions, technical trade-offs and secure-by-design development. Run threat-modelling exercises and support developers with secure coding practices across Node.js, React Native and C++ environments. Own vulnerability management, including triage, risk prioritisation, remediation tracking and incident response where required. Develop and improve the logging, monitoring and alerting capabilities needed to identify and respond to security threats. Assess emerging threats, including those associated with AI-enabled products, tooling and new attack methodologies, and ensure our security approach continues to evolve. Strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 controls, identifying gaps and improving implementation where needed. Support compliance cycles including controls testing, evidence gathering and auditor coordination. Support GDPR and data residency requirements across our infrastructure and data pipelines. Engage with enterprise customers and prospects on XYZ Reality’s security posture when required. Automate security controls and processes wherever possible rather than relying on manual intervention. Help establish the standards, tooling and operating model for a security capability that can scale with the business. What We’re Looking For Demonstrable in-depth hands-on technical security experience, ideally spanning application, cloud and/or infrastructure security. Strong technical security capability and the confidence to own security decisions end-to-end rather than operating purely in an advisory or governance capacity. Strong cloud security experience, ideally Azure, although significant AWS or GCP expertise with the ability to transition quickly to Azure would also be considered. Hands-on experience securing Kubernetes/containerised environments, including IAM, RBAC, network segmentation, secrets management, image scanning and pod security. Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD environments, including SAST, DAST, SCA and dependency scanning. Experience with infrastructure-as-code security and technologies such as Terraform, Helm or GitOps. Understanding of application and API security, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS and secure development practices. Experience identifying vulnerabilities, assessing technical risk and driving remediation. Comfortable writing automation using Python, Go, Bash or similar to operationalise security controls. Practical experience working with SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001, including identifying gaps and strengthening controls. Current knowledge of the evolving cybersecurity landscape and an interest in emerging threats, particularly those associated with AI. Strong communication skills and the ability to translate security requirements for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A pragmatic, collaborative approach, you understand that great security enables engineering teams rather than creating unnecessary barriers. Experience building or scaling security capability within a high-growth or Series A/B technology business would be particularly valuable. You’ll understand the balance between addressing today’s risks and building security foundations capable of supporting where the business is heading next. Above all, we’re looking for someone who is technically strong, curious and proactive, someone engineers want to work with, who can bring credibility to security conversations while remaining pragmatic about how we build and ship great technology. description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the role We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press. Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate. This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice. What you'll do Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally. Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility. Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences. Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most. Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press. Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it. Bring AI into the workflow : Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice. What we're looking for Experience Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast) Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential Skills Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality. Ways of working Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted What we offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead. Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.title: Principal Partner Account Manager
raw.description:
We are looking for a Principal Partner Account Manager to join our EMEA and APJ teams. Siteimprove is a global leader in digital accessibility, content optimisation, and web governance, empowering organisations to deliver inclusive, high-performing digital experiences. With the launch of Siteimprove.ai, the only enterprise platform that unifies content compliance and content performance, we are leading the way in the AI era, where content must perform for both humans and AI.
 
In this role, you will help build and activate a modern channel strategy, partnering with digital agencies and value-added consulting firms that work across Accessibility, SEO, Marketing Performance, and broader Digital Experience technologies. This is a high-impact opportunity to co-create new go-to-market models and influence the growth of a critical function at a pivotal stage in Siteimprove’s evolution.
 
You will work closely with partners to uncover challenges, deliver impactful solutions through Siteimprove’s SaaS platform, and drive measurable results for customers across EMEA and APJ. From accessibility to SEO/AIO, analytics, and content strategy, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organisations to optimise high-performing, compliant content that is discoverable by all.
 
This is a strategic, quota-carrying role in our growth journey and a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact in a purpose-driven, fast-paced, and international organisation. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. If you are excited about the opportunity and aligned with our mission, we would love to hear from you.

What you will be doing
  • Work autonomously: Own the partner function in your territory with minimal direction, managing the full lifecycle of partner engagement.
  • Conduct market and partner analysis across EMEA and APJ regions.
  • Recruit and onboard partners in the respective regions.
  • Develop compelling value propositions tailored to EMEA and APJ markets.
  • Plan and execute joint go-to-market initiatives in the regions.
  • Align with field teams and track revenue impact locally.
  • Define and evolve our partner model: Build a partner strategy emphasizing inclusion, accessibility impact, and long-term commercial value.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Sales, Partner Marketing, Global Operations, and Customer Success to ensure successful field execution.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner: Partner with senior leadership to define what success looks like for partnerships in Siteimprove’s next growth phase.

    • FedRAMP Classification Notice 

    This position is currently designated as Out of Scope for FedRAMP-authorized systems and environments. Individuals in this role are not expected to require access to systems or data within the FedRAMP authorization boundary as part of their regular job responsibilities. 

    If business needs change and the role is expanded to include access to FedRAMP-authorized systems or data, any required verification, authorization, confidentiality, or access-control requirements must be successfully completed before such access is granted. 


    What we will require of you
  • 10+ years of experience in SaaS, with at least 4 years in channel partnerships, alliances, or business development.
  • Experience managing and achieving sales targets or driving measurable revenue growth.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to influence partner investment to drive mutual growth.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences, including executives.
  • Experience building partner strategies in fast-changing environments, including value-added resellers or consulting firms with agency or martech knowledge.
  • Comfortable contributing at both strategic and operational levels, adapting to the needs of the business.
  • Travel as needed.

    • What we will love about you
  • Direct experience in one or more complementary technology ecosystems, including Accessibility, Content Management, DXP, Marketing Automation, SEO, Commerce, Personalization, or Predictive Analytics.
  • Operates with a balance of vision, strategy, and execution, taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Builds credibility and trust with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborative approach: Works seamlessly with account executives and sales teams, enhancing sales cycles rather than competing over deals.
  • Prior experience in mid-size SaaS companies (~$100–250M ARR) and understanding agency dynamics is a plus.
    •  

    What you'll love about us
    We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

    In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

    At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our UK benefits are designed to help you stay healthy, maintain a healthy work-life balance, and plan confidently for the future.

    Rest and relaxation: 25 days of annual holiday, plus support for flexible and sustainable commuting to our London office.

    Comprehensive benefits: Private medical coverage through Bupa, wellbeing and employee support services through Canada Life, and a weekly lunch allowance.

    Prepare for the future: Company pension benefits through Aviva to help support your long-term financial goals.
